theme_and_archetype.rationale: High-stakes interview prep requires trust and authority. We avoid the typical purple/teal 'AI slop' and instead use a stark, editorial aesthetic (bone white, charcoal, and one sharp signal orange accent) to make the app feel like a premium, trustworthy tool rather than a generic tech demo. The camera and feedback should be the absolute focus, so the UI must fade away.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-medium

rules: Headings strictly use Cabinet Grotesk with tight tracking.
Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
Data labels and system statuses should use JetBrains Mono in uppercase.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento 'Control Room' grid for dashboard and feedback reports. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text and data. Center-align only major empty states or specific modal content.

rules: Keep animations purposeful. Do not overuse bouncy physics.
UI elements should feel snappy and responsive.

avatar_placeholder_1.description: Professional headshot for mock session history.

rules: All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute.
Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='start-interview-button', data-testid='camera-preview', data-testid='download-feedback-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is used for headings and 'Figtree' for body text. Load from Google Fonts or Fontshare.
Do NOT use typical SaaS blue/purple gradients. Stick strictly to the bone white (#F9F8F6) background with pure white cards, and Vermilion Red (#FF4500) for primary actions.
The camera recording UI should be the centerpiece: simple, no clutter, floating glassmorphic controls at the bottom, and a sharp red recording dot at the top.
For the real-time question display, use a prominent overlapping card or a clean bottom-third overlay on the video feed so the user doesn't have to look away from the camera.
Use Lucide-React for crisp, minimal icons.
Ensure the feedback report page uses a 'Control Room' grid (Bento box style) to display scores, strengths, and weaknesses clearly.
All components must be fully accessible and include proper ARIA and data-testid attributes.
